Class Transcript

java.lang.Object
org.roux.token.Transcript
public final class Transcript extends Object
The Transcript is the ordered text that a token estimate counts. Turns are stored from oldest to newest. A mood head is the text stored before the first turn. A mood head is not a turn. rendered() writes a non-empty half and then one newline. An empty half adds nothing. // @aa-sdd GK-1074 aetheris-plan-f-174.001.md FINESSE:f-174

    • rendered

      public String rendered()
      The method builds the counted string. A stored mood head is written first. Each non-empty half is written next, followed by one newline. Zero turns and no mood head return an empty string.
      Returns:
      The string is the rendered transcript.
